# SmartCutAI (remove-photo-bg)

> Browser-native, 100% private AI background removal powered by BiRefNet and ONNX
> Runtime Web (WebGPU and SIMD WebAssembly). Every image is segmented locally on
> the user's device; no image pixels are ever transmitted to a server.

## Key facts

- Privacy architecture: there is no image-upload code path in the app. The page is
  served with a strict Content Security Policy (`default-src 'self'`) and the
  model is fetched once, then cached in the browser Cache API so later runs work
  offline.
- Segmentation model: Background Model 512 (INT8/FP16), technical id
  `birefnet-lite-engine-512-int8-fp16`, ~58 MB (60,763,193 bytes), SHA-256 pinned
  in `public/models-manifest.json`.
- Measured parity with the FP32 teacher: IoU@0.5 0.998726 with 0 pixels crossing
  the 0.5 alpha threshold on the parity sample.
- Inference latency: ~3.6–4.0 s warm per image on a desktop CPU (multi-threaded
  WASM SIMD), ~6.9 s on a phone. Hardware WebGPU is selected automatically when
  available and can be overridden in Studio Engine Controls.
- Evaluation: 64 licence-verified photos across 8 categories; 64/64 processed with
  no errors, 59/64 produced a usable first-pass cut-out.
- Input limits: 20 MB and 4096 px on the longest side. Exports: transparent PNG,
  white-background JPG, and WebP. Batch processing handles up to 5 photos.
- Post-processing: mask threshold 0–100%, mask feather 0–64 px, tiled inference,
  guided-filter edge refinement, flood-mask recovery, and a retouch brush.

- [Privacy policy](/PRIVACY.md): why image data never leaves the browser.
